topics.reference_answer: Mamba, introduced by Gu & Dao (2023), extends structured state space models (S4) with input-selective SSM parameters, enabling linear-time sequence modeling competitive with Transformers. In clinical time-series forecasting, SSMs offer advantages over Transformers: linear memory complexity, strong performance on long sequences (e.g., ICU monitoring on MIMIC-III/IV), and efficient inference. Key challenges include: (1) evaluating on established MIMIC benchmarks (mortality prediction, length-of-stay), (2) data scarcity and label imbalance in clinical settings, (3) interpretability requirements in healthcare. Evidence for Mamba in clinical settings remains early-stage; the literature is dominated by promising but limited benchmarks rather than large-scale validated deployments.
